subject: Superintendent Roy Belson Retirement Announcement
overview: Superintendent Roy Belson announced his retirement effective June 30, 2018, prompting discussions on the transition and search process. The committee also accepted major donations from Stop & Shop, approved technology infrastructure grant matching funds, and handled routine district business.

items.title: Approval of Minutes, Bills, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the October 16, 2017 meeting, bills and fund transfers, and regular payrolls.

items.title: Report on Project 351
items.summary: Received a presentation recognizing student ambassadors for Project 351, including Andrews Middle School eighth-grader Ava Heinegg.

items.title: Community Participation
items.summary: Tabled a scheduled CPAC update due to illness and heard from Medford Teachers Association President Charlene Douglas regarding middle school action plan concerns and teacher grievances.

items.title: Appointment of School Physician
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Dr. Patrick Sabia as the new school physician to succeed Dr. Kristen Goodell.

items.title: Report on Tier 2 E-Rate Funding Award
items.summary: Voted to accept federal Category 2 E-rate funding for network infrastructure improvements and request a $291,150 match from the City Council.

items.title: Report on Veterans Day Program
items.summary: Received a report on the secondary schools' 17th annual Veterans Day program and voted to send official thank-you letters to participants and donors.

items.title: Acceptance of Stop & Shop Donation
items.summary: Voted to accept a $10,000 gift from Stop & Shop for the vocational Bistro 489 as well as $7,500 to fund a district-wide free lunch day.

items.title: Foreign Language Field Trip and Student Scholarship
items.summary: Approved an overnight AP Italian class trip to New York City funded by a private scholarship, and recognized student Sandra Figueroa for receiving the FAA USA Italian study scholarship.

items.title: SkillsUSA Conference Participation
items.summary: Voted to approve attendance by vocational students and chaperones at the SkillsUSA State Leadership Conference in Marlborough.

items.title: Report on Professional Development Day
items.summary: Received a summary of district-wide staff workshops conducted on November 7, focusing on Response to Intervention and school climate initiatives.

items.title: Report on MSBA School Maintenance Study
items.summary: Received and placed on file a state school building assessment report evaluating Medford school facility conditions and capacity utilization.

items.title: Superintendent Succession Plan and Retirement
items.summary: Superintendent Roy Belson formally announced his retirement effective June 30, 2018, concluding 50 years with Medford Public Schools, and the committee scheduled an initial transition meeting with the Massachusetts Association of School Committees.

items.title: Condolence, Congratulatory Resolutions, and Theater Lighting
items.summary: Passed resolutions expressing condolences to families of staff members, congratulated Paulette Van der Kloot on the birth of her grandson, and voted to invite donor John Costas to a future meeting for theater lighting contributions.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted by roll call to enter executive session to discuss negotiations and legal matters.
